## Overview

Development of an embedded processing board for a universal mechanical testing machine.

## Signals

- Force.
- Displacement.
- Deformation.
- Speed.

## Technology

- Zybo Z10.
- Vivado.
- VHDL.
- FPGA-based digital processing.
